description: Deribit public REST option instrument listings (get_instruments, listed and recently expired) and DVOL volatility index data (get_volatility_index_data) for BTC and ETH
permission_basis: Public market data served without authentication by Deribit public REST endpoints (/public/get_instruments, /public/get_volatility_index_data), used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. Deribit Terms of Service and API documentation reviewed 2026-11-18. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
timestamp_basis: Instrument expiration_timestamp is the settlement moment in UTC milliseconds (08:00 UTC on the expiry date). DVOL daily points are timestamped at 00:00 UTC; a daily point's close becomes knowable at the next day's 00:00 UTC.
